purpose: Execute the atomic split-face-parametrically operation within the MA-24 boundary: One in-place split of a current face by supplied trimmed curves through SplitFace.ByCurves. Curve construction, face discovery, body separation, and feature naming are caller-owned or separate operations.
trigger: Use when the build plan requires split-face-parametrically and all declared inputs have been resolved for the current SpaceClaim V21 action boundary.

inputs.name: body
inputs.description: The current body containing the target face.

inputs.name: curves
inputs.description: Trimmed splitting curves supplied in the target-face context.

inputs.name: bbox_tolerance_mm
inputs.description: Tolerance for identifying the changed parent body by bounds.

preconditions: body is a current root DesignBody and face is a current face owned by it.
curves is nonempty and contains usable trimmed splitting curves.
bbox_tolerance_mm and volume_tolerance_mm3 are finite and nonnegative.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: {body: current parent DesignBody, faces: current face array, added_face_count: positive integer}.

postconditions: SplitFace.ByCurves succeeds with MakeCurves=false and leaves the target parent body in the current root design.
The changed parent body is reacquired by matching pre-operation bounds and volume within the supplied tolerances.
The current face count increases by at least one and the returned added_face_count records the increase.

implementation.target_environment: SpaceClaim V21 / IronPython 2.7 action wrapper; runtime execution is evidenced by the attached exact candidate host record; native persistence, visual review, and requested export remain outside this action.
implementation.notes: Execute the atomic split-face-parametrically operation within the MA-24 boundary: One in-place split of a current face by supplied trimmed curves through SplitFace.ByCurves. Curve construction, face discovery, body separation, and feature naming are caller-owned or separate operations. Untested variants remain outside the attached exact-run evidence.

ambiguity_checks: Zero or multiple matches must stop the action; numbered aliases and return order are not valid identity criteria.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Re-enumerate current root bodies and faces after SplitFace.ByCurves; all pre-operation face references must be reacquired.

failure_modes.condition: Body/face ownership, curve nonemptiness, or tolerance validation fails before the split call.
failure_modes.detection: Body/face ownership, curve nonemptiness, or tolerance validation fails before the split call.
failure_modes.safe_state: Stop downstream use until the declared recovery is completed from a clean state.

failure_modes.condition: SplitFace.ByCurves reports failure or no changed parent with an increased face count is found.
failure_modes.detection: SplitFace.ByCurves reports failure or no changed parent with an increased face count is found.
failure_modes.safe_state: Treat the document as potentially partially mutated; do not promote downstream references.

recovery.action: Re-enumerate the current parent and face, supply nonempty compatible trimmed curves, and rerun without a command call.
Treat the document as potentially partially mutated, reopen a clean run-owned copy, repair curve/face compatibility, and rerun.
